square.why: The summit town on the cavern's top bench. Its middle already stands -- the 16x16 summit square at y46 with the cairn carried down from the Scar in its centre (TOWN_SQUARES_SURVEY 2) -- but nowhere sold anything. Two tents on the square's free corners sell only what a town living underground makes for itself: light and what grows in the dark.
